title: I Posted the Vending-Card Photo After They Ran Snacks on My Balance

parts.text: I checked the vending app at 3:12 p.m. and three snack charges sat on my numbered card. Tess from sales had the spare fob they "borrowed" in June. I was twenty-seven, analyst, holding a screenshot that listed my name. I photographed the charges, the fob drawer, and the sign that said ONE CARD PER PERSON. Then I posted the photo on the kitchen board. At 3:19 facilities pinged Tess. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Tess repaid the snacks. Policy now has a second line: SPARE FOBS ARE NOT SHARED. I keep my card in my pocket.

social.video_title: They ran snacks on my numbered vending card — Part 1/1
social.description: Three charges, a June spare fob, a one-card sign. Would you have posted the photo?
